question:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube, which of the given figures is/are possible?

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ed4922215550eb8d30260fb9b9ccc782f2de36b73b292f86ea160a83d4344fd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41e3506a043ff4c5cfbf75e2579912dccbfe2eee563b4ab866ecc19ee2a30ebe.png]
solution:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube,

Opposite numbers:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e57385b5aa5579d0b4f78ed2e7500ecc095a8f60e382496eb415876b8b9cacc1.png] 

3 ⇒ 5 

6 ⇒ 1

4 ⇒ 2

Lets check each figure and verify which is/are possible:

A → This cube is possible to form as all these are adjacent numbers

B → This cube is possible to form as all these are adjacent numbers

C → This cube cannot be formed as 4 is opposite to 2 and not adjacent

D → This cube cannot be formed as 5 is opposite to 3 and not adjacent

Thus, **only A and B are possible**.

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
